caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic figurine of a small dog standing on a rectangular base. The dog is primarily white with a textured, dotted surface on its body, particularly around the chest area, which also features a red and orange circular floral-like marking. The face of the dog has a slightly upturned nose, black eyes, and a mouth outlined in red, with similar reddish highlights on its ears and near its mouth. The base of the figure is also mainly white, with patches of green and red suggesting grass or decorative detailing. The background of the drawing is a uniform, light beige color without additional objects or details.
title: Chalkware Dog
